title: Can Optimal Dispatch Models Recreate Reality? A Retrospective Analysis of Europe's 2022 Energy Crisis Using PyPSA-Eur
summary: Electricity prices result from the complex interplay of supply and demand, which depends on variable renewable energy production, fuel costs, CO$_2$ price, and grid bottlenecks.Between 2020 and 2024, COVID-19 shifted demand and disrupted supply chains and operations in Europe, while Russia's invasion of Ukraine constrained gas supply, causing exceptional volatility in gas prices. It remains unclear whether optimal dispatch models can reliably replicate historical hourly prices during crises, given the rapid fluctuations in fuel prices and operators' limited foresight. In this work, we ask…
